claims.claim: The Konica Minolta Bizhub Pro C754e is a large, full colour, laser multifunctional printer.
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows the Konica Minolta logo and bizhub PRO C754e text on a large office copier with a control panel and four paper trays.

risks.risk: The machine does not power on.
risks.proof: Video of the machine being switched on and reaching a ready screen.

risks.risk: It does not print, copy, or scan correctly.
risks.proof: Video of a test print, copy, and scan with the output shown.

risks.risk: Page count or meter reading is unknown.
risks.proof: Photo or screenshot of the meter or counter report.

risks.risk: Drums, toner, or other consumables are depleted or near end of life.
risks.proof: Photos of consumable status screens or remaining-life indicators.

risks.risk: Not all paper trays and feeders work.
risks.proof: Video of paper feeding from each tray and feeder.

risks.risk: Error codes or poor service history are hidden.
risks.proof: Screenshot of the error log or service history records.
risks.if_unproven: as unknown service history with possible errors

risks.risk: Power cord or cables are not included.
risks.proof: Photo of the power cord and any interface cables included.

proof_requests: Video of the machine powering on and reaching a ready screen
Video of a test print, copy, and scan showing output
Photo of the page count or meter reading
Photos of drum, toner, and consumable levels
Video of each paper tray and feeder in operation
Screenshot of error codes or service history
Photo of the included power cord and cables
response.reason: The witness identifies the Konica Minolta bizhub PRO C754e from the photo label, so the item is known; functionality and condition are unproven, so it is priced at worst case pending proof.
